messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up (RFC-145): we need a concrete rollout plan for kernel-selection + attention opt flags. Post-RFC action items I want to lock down:

maria: 1) flag granularity (global / model / model-version / kernel-variant), 2) fallback mapping semantics, 3) telemetry events + SLOs for gating, 4) emergency kill switch, 5) API for per-model enablement.

sam: +1. can we avoid per-model flags exploding? propose a hierarchy: global -> model-pattern -> model-version. model-pattern supports globs.

jordan: hierarchy sounds good. also need default fallback mapping table: if kernel X fails at runtime, route to kernel Y with cost cap. want an ordered list and a max-latency budget.

anya: thinking about rollout cadence: canaries at 1% traffic for 30m with synthetic smoke tests, then 10% for 2h, then 100% if no errors. add automatic rollback if error-rate > 0.5% or median latency regresses > 20%.

maria: noted. we should codify the metrics and thresholds. telemetry events: kernel.rollout.start, kernel.rollout.step, kernel.rollout.rollback, kernel.fallback.invoked, kernel.kvcache.miss_rate. tag events with model_id, kernel_variant, rollout_id, route_id.

sam: for per-model enablement API, something like: PATCH /internal/flags/models/{model_id} body: { enabled: true, kernel: "xform-8k-q4", rollout_id: "r-123" }

jordan: also need a control-plane-only dry-run mode where we simulate routing decisions without affecting live traffic, and surface the expected telemetry. very helpful to validate fallback maps.

anya: ops questions: who can flip these flags? UI vs CLI vs infra-api. propose: UI for safe rollouts, CLI for power users, infra-api for automation. RBAC: only eng-runtime-admins + SRE on prod.

maria: emergency kill-switch: global boolean that forces all requests to the stable fallback kernel (eg: baseline-1). Should be guarded with 2-person approval and audit log. ops-bot should record approvals.

ops-bot: deploy approval required: @sam and @anya must approve to toggle kill-switch in prod.

deploy-bot: reminder: rollout jobs require a deploy token and create a rollout resource (rollout_id) that is immutable.

sam: example flag config (proposal):
```
flags:
  global:
    kernel_enable: true
  models:
    - pattern: "gpt-*"
      kernel: "attn-opt-v2"
      rollout: "r-2026-03-18-gptv2"
      fallback:
        - kernel: "attn-opt-v1"
          max_latency_ms: 1200
        - kernel: "baseline-1"
          max_latency_ms: 3000
    - model_id: "customer-abc/v1"
      kernel: "quant-cpu-fast"
      rollout: "r-2026-03-19-custabc"
```

jordan: love the fallback list. we should also attach cost_estimate_threshold per-fallback so routing can prefer cheaper fallbacks when latency budget allows.

maria: telemetry and SLOs: add counters for fallback invocations per kernel pair and histogram for fallback latency. create dashboard: rollouts by status, fallback-rate by model, 95p latency by kernel.

anya: post-RFC tracking: propose a small milestone board in the eng-runtime repo: tasks: 1) implement flag hierarchy (2w), 2) fallback mapping + control API (1w), 3) telemetry hooks (1w), 4) UI + RBAC (2w), 5) rollout automation + dry-run (2w). total ~8w with overlap.

sam: testing matrix: unit tests for routing logic, integration tests that spin up 3 kernels and simulate failures, chaos runs that kill a kernel mid-rollout. add perf check for KV cache behavior under fallback.

jordan: interface boundary note: runtime should expose a deterministic routing decision API for auditing: given request metadata + flags + rollout-id => predicted kernel. important for reproducing incidents. keep implementation internal but stable wire format.

maria: can someone volunteer to own the RFC->implementation tracking and the milestone board?

sam: I can take ownership of the flag hierarchy + control API.

anya: I can do telemetry + dashboards and RBAC UI.

jordan: I'll own fallback mapping, cost thresholds, and the deterministic routing API.

maria: thanks. action items for this thread:
- sam: implement flag API + prototype (due 2026-04-01)
- jordan: fallback mapping + deterministic API spec (due 2026-03-28)
- anya: telemetry + dashboard prototype (due 2026-03-30)
- maria: write rollout playbook with emergency steps (due 2026-03-26)

maria: one more: add a short example to docs for customers wanting per-model override via tenant config. customers should be able to opt out of experimental kernels.

sam: acked. adding doc item to my PR.

jordan: putting the deterministic routing API stub in the repo now.

maria: thanks all. I'll create the milestone board and tag tasks. if anyone wants to push up the cadence we can split the first two weeks across two squads.

anya: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: rollout resource r-2026-03-18-gptv2 created by sam at 1979990200

maria: closing thread with follow-ups. will ping for weekly sync on Thursday.
